name: monthly_compound_deposit_fee_bump_interest_tally
question_template: A savings account opens with USD {PRINCIPAL} at the start of month 1 and runs {MONTHS} months at a base nominal annual rate of {RATE} percent. Each month end, interest equal to the month's opening balance times that month's nominal annual rate divided by 1200 is credited, then a USD {FEE} fee is deducted. A deposit of USD {DEPOSIT} is posted at the beginning of month {DEP_MONTH}, so it is in that month's opening balance. An adjustment of {BUMP_BP} basis points is added to the nominal annual rate {BUMP_MODE}: 'once' means in month {DEP_MONTH} only; 'ongoing' means in every month from month {DEP_MONTH} through month {MONTHS}. Total interest earned means the sum of monthly interest credits, not the balance change. Effective annual rate means the base rate's monthly-compounded equivalent in percent. Report the total interest earned in USD.

slots.description: Interest credited at the end of the deposit month, in USD
Account balance after the final month's interest credit and fee, in USD
Effective annual rate of the base nominal rate with monthly compounding, in percent

program:
def solve():
    principal = Fraction(P["PRINCIPAL"])
    base_rate = Fraction(P["RATE"])
    n = P["MONTHS"]
    k = P["DEP_MONTH"]
    deposit = Fraction(P["DEPOSIT"])
    bump = Fraction(P["BUMP_BP"]) / 100
    mode = P["BUMP_MODE"]
    fee = Fraction(P["FEE"])
    if k > n:
        raise ValueError("deposit month is beyond the account term")
    bal = principal
    total_interest = Fraction(0)
    interest_k = Fraction(0)
    for m in range(1, n + 1):
        if m == k:
            bal = bal + deposit
        annual = base_rate
        if (mode == "once" and m == k) or (mode == "ongoing" and m >= k):
            annual = base_rate + bump
        if annual < 0:
            raise ValueError("negative nominal rate")
        interest = bal * annual / 1200
        if m == k:
            interest_k = interest
        total_interest = total_interest + interest
        bal = bal + interest - fee
    ear = ((1 + base_rate / 1200) ** 12 - 1) * 100
    return {
        "final": total_interest,
        "interest_month_k": interest_k,
        "ending_balance": bal,
        "effective_annual_rate": ear
    }
